newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures higher in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures higher in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were higher in after-hours trade on Tuesday, on light buying orders from local investors, traders said.
Prices were 0.2 to 0.5 yen higher than the day's close, and the benchmark May was 0.5 yen higher at 146.5 yen per kg.
During the day, all months were weaker during the morning session on the yen's gains against the dollar, traders said.
Light technical-based trading dominated the market today, and the yen/dollar rate was a major factor, traders said. The spot December month expires this Friday.
